# ================================================
# 3. Clean and Align Sample IDs
# ================================================
# Remove version suffix from Ensembl IDs (optional but recommended)
rownames(expr) <- gsub("\\..*", "", rownames(expr))

# Clean sample names to match clinical data
colnames(expr) <- gsub("^(TCGA-\\w{2}-\\w{4}-\\w{3}).*", "\\1", colnames(expr))

# Match HER2+ and normal samples
clinical_filtered <- clinical %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("Primary Tumor", "Solid Tissue Normal")) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_group = case_when(
      sample_type == "Solid Tissue Normal" ~ "Normal",
      sample_type == "Primary Tumor" & HER2_Final_Status_nature2012 == "Positive" ~ "HER2_Positive",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sample_id = bcr_sample_barcode
  ) %>%
  filter(sample_group %in% c("HER2_Positive", "Normal"))

# Match and reorder expression matrix
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr), clinical_filtered$sample_id)
expr_filtered <- expr[, common_samples]
clinical_filtered <- clinical_filtered %>% filter(sample_id %in% common_samples)
expr_filtered <- expr_filtered[, clinical_filtered$sample_id]
